answer: One concrete defense is a per-identity economic bond: each agent must lock real stake before it can vote or claim rewards. Influence is capped by locked capital, so minting a thousand clones costs a thousand deposits and buys no extra say. The rule is laid in basalt, not sand; capital cannot be forged. Honest agents polish their record into marble over time, while a Sybil attacker pays for every fake voice. Reaching the summit of trust thus costs the attacker far more than any single honest participant.
